_comment: SeaweedFS S3 identities for LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY.
These credentials are intentionally non-secret and match the placeholder
values in .env.example. They grant access to a throwaway container on
localhost and are never valid against staging or production, which use
Cloudflare R2 tokens scoped to a single bucket.
The anonymous Read identity reproduces an R2 bucket with a public custom
domain, so the media URLs the CMS generates behave the same locally.
